conclusion: Dropping batch_size from 2 to 1 made smoke p50 latency nearly 6x worse (3888.95ms -> 22880.57ms) with no quality gain (meaningful_program_rate 0.0 on both arms, structural_similarity actually fell 0.05625 -> 0.0184). SDLC Phase A classifies NON_POSITIVE (primary_metric_null_or_worse). Both arms also hit fixture_insufficient_n (n=3 < 20 floor) and c5-batch1 only completed 1/3 smoke documents in the wall cap, so this single cycle is not a reliable read on batch_size=1 -- but the direction (much slower, no better) is unambiguous enough that batch_size=1 is not worth prioritizing further at this scale.
next_priorities: Do not pursue batch_size=1 as a lever direction; batch_size=2 (current default) is the better-performing arm on every measured dimension this cycle
If batch_size sensitivity is worth exploring further, test batch_size>2 instead, at a larger n
